final: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(client.client_id) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id JOIN account ON account.district_id = district.district_id JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id AND disp.account_id = account.account_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
